notes.title: New update
notes.content:
Hi!

There has been an update for Stay Dead Evolution, including a better balancing. All difficulty levels are now immediatly unlockable, you are now free to choose the best fighting experience for you! 

The bonus stage has been revamped, and the WASD key mapping has also been added.
